blurb: Guests embark on a shared hot air balloon flight experience lifting off together from a location 16 miles north of Moab. The flight includes transportation to the launch site and a return shuttle from the landing site. Flights offer views over Arches, Canyonlands, and the desert landscapes of southern Utah.
